brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu attacked Israel's Arab political parties, accusing them of election fraud, as his coalition negotiations left him short of a parliamentary majority, Al Jazeera English reported. The accusations came amid coalition talks following elections in which no single bloc secured an outright majority.

Palestinian-Israeli parties have historically played a significant role in Israeli politics, particularly in coalition-building scenarios. Netanyahu's public criticism of the Arab parties marked an escalation in his rhetoric surrounding the electoral process and coalition formation.
dek: Israel’s Prime Minister accused Palestinian-Israeli parties of election fraud.
title: Netanyahu accuses Arab parties of fraud as coalition falls short
